name: zeroclaw
notes: Rust rewrite of OpenClaw: 3.4MB-ish static bin, <5MB RAM, 10ms boot, 22+ providers, SQLite hybrid memory, 'zeroclaw migrate openclaw' import. Official aarch64-linux-android asset = ZERO patching, verified runs (0.8.5). SHA256SUMS from same latest/download URL. Tarball also ships web/dist dashboard; extract to lib dir, wrapper in bin. Onboard: zeroclaw onboard --api-key ...; daemon: zeroclaw daemon.
